AS
DECLARE VARIABLE V_EMAIL VARCHAR(100);
BEGIN

    SELECT U.EMAIL
    FROM USUARIO U
    WHERE U.ID_USUARIO = NEW.ID_USUARIO
    INTO :V_EMAIL;
   
   
   
   

    EXECUTE STATEMENT
        'INSERT INTO HISTORICO
        (
            EMAIL,
            DISPOSITIVO,
            DATA_HORA,
            TABELA,
            CAMPO,
            ACAO,
            CAMPO_ANTIGO,
            CAMPO_NOVO
        )
        VALUES (
            ''' || V_EMAIL || ''',
            ''' || NEW.DISPOSITIVO || ''',
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            ''CATEGORIA'',
            ''ID_CATEGORIA - STATUS - TIPO - DESCRICAO'',
            ''INSERT'',
            '''',
            ''' ||
                NEW.ID_CATEGORIA || ' - ' ||
                NEW.STATUS || ' - ' ||
                NEW.TIPO || ' - ' ||
                NEW.DESCRICAO ||
            '''
        )'

    ON EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE
        'localhost:C:\Users\Aluno\Desktop\GuadalupeGestao-Back\BANCOLOG.FDB'
    AS USER 'SYSDBA'
    PASSWORD 'sysdba';

END
